cards.card_text: They're a byword among the nations and a laughingstock, and shame covers his face at the voice of the scorner and the reviler, the enemy bent on revenge.
cards.verse_text: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples. All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face, at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
